Name: Nyapu's Style - Mirren The Florist
Author: Jupm
Description:
[center][b][color=#d9ead3][size=5]Nyapu's Style - Mirren The F[/size][/color][/b][b][color=#d9ead3][size=5]lorist[/size][/color][/b][/center][b][color=#d9ead3][size=5]
[/size][/color][/b][size=3]This mod is a [CP] version, meaning you just need to extract the file to your mods folder and everything should work!
This mod makes the portraits of the NPC [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39733?tab=description]Mirren The Florist[/url] look like Nyapu's drawing style.

The mod contains seasonal and festival portraits for Mirren, as well as a portrait for Sarah (an NPC who appears during an event).

[b][color=#d9ead3]New in version 1.1.0[/color][/b]
With the new update you can use GMCM to choose whether you want portraits with hair down or up, and you can also choose whether you want Mirren to wear glasses or not.

I would like to thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Specialagentjonson?gameId=1303]Specialagentjonson[/url] for creating this AMAZING NPC, I became obsessed with him, I think I've never drawn anything so fast in my whole life hahaha!
A huge thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Blossom5280]Blossom5280[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye?gameId=1303]Abagaianye[/url] who helped with the code![/size]

Downloads.Description: Update with new options, long or tied hair, and with or without glasses.
